name: Dobot MG400 · fixed-nozzle relay extrusion
boundsBasis: Proposed software design envelope only; configured instance workspace required for export. Not robot reachability.

tools.label: Fixed external relay extruder (proposed 0.4 mm setup)

outputs.extrusionUnits: relay-on-off; commanded volume is intent only

startup.validation: Unconfigured installation: frame, calibration, workspace, initial pose, controller limits, relay rate/policy and external temperature control must be supplied before export.

nonplanar.basis: Proposed software limit for fixed-orientation XYZ skills; not a measured clearance rating.
nonplanar.validation: No physical validation of this adapter.

validation: Software adoption of selected legacy Lua runtime and installation concepts. No real instance calibration supplied; no hardware run or physical validation. Bounds/feed/nozzle/material defaults are proposals, not measured machine specifications.

exportGuidance.contract: ZIP contains global.lua helpers, src1.lua RunPlan, src0.lua entry and manifest.json. Experimental stroke-stop-start-unblended policy must be explicitly selected. Relay remains on through consecutive deposition moves, switches off for travel and dwell. CP=0, no startup move, no priming dwell. External temperature control and initial positioning are prerequisites. Joint motion, rotation changes, arcs, tool changes, retraction, fan control and kinematics/collision validation are unsupported.
exportGuidance.legacyDifference: The legacy reference kept the relay on through travel and inserted priming waits. This bounded adapter deliberately requires a separately selected stroke switching policy; it does not reproduce that reference behavior.
